description: Marketing partner commission processing environment for the January 2026 payout cycle. Contains closed-deal records, partner commission tiers, an open-disputes log, and supporting policy/directory references. commission_policy_manual.content: Partner Commission Policy v3.2. Commission = net_deal_value x tier commission_rate. Rates are set by the partner's current tier on ws_tiers. Deals tied to any unresolved dispute are held from the current payout cycle and rolled to the next eligible cycle once the dispute is resolved. Statements are issued monthly after Finance review. Values must be carried verbatim from source records.

payout_calendar_2026.content: 2026 partner payout calendar. January cycle: calculations due Jan 28, statements reviewed Jan 29, payouts initiated Feb 3. February cycle: calculations due Feb 25. Held deals roll to the next cycle after dispute resolution.
